_about: The embed gate's expected screens. A sign review is approved only on an exact match with one entry of signFaces (judge.mjs). A change to what TinyCloud One asks for, or to OpenKey's review copy, makes the gate fail closed until this file is updated in a reviewed change. Sources: the TinyCloud One sign-in face observed 2026-11-22 (QA fixture p2/x12, renewal and 30-day forms), OpenKey apps/web signing-approval.svelte, #685 framed-terms-notice.svelte.
